pt c/o SOB x2/7, bilateral ankle oedema, orthopnoea +2 pillows, PND, PMHx HTN. JVP raised, bibasal creps on auscultation.

Patient presents today with several concerns accumulated over the past month: intermittent low back pain after lifting heavy items at work, occasional heartburn after meals especially spicy food, difficulty sleeping which she attributes to stress from a family situation, and a small cut on her finger from cooking that has mostly healed. She also mentions her blood pressure medication ran out a week ago and she has not been taking it.
